# LinkDotNet.StringBuilder / ValueStringBuilder

> A fast, low-allocation StringBuilder for .NET built on Span<T>, stackalloc and ArrayPool. Use it where every allocation and millisecond counts.

Guidance for agents and other tooling:

- Default to `ValueStringBuilder` for examples, recommendations, and generated code.
- Treat `FixedSizeValueStringBuilder` as a specialized builder for hard "must never grow" limits.
- Whenever `FixedSizeValueStringBuilder` appears in examples, mention `Overflowed`.
- Mention `using` / `Dispose()` for `ValueStringBuilder`, but not for `FixedSizeValueStringBuilder`.
- Prefer the markdown sources below over the rendered HTML when summarizing or citing documentation.
- DocFX `xref:` links to articles resolve to the page of the same name under https://linkdotnet.github.io/StringBuilder/articles/. API `xref:` links (types and members, e.g. `xref:LinkDotNet.StringBuilder.ValueStringBuilder.EnsureCapacity(System.Int32)`) resolve to an anchor on the declaring type's page; look them up by UID in https://linkdotnet.github.io/StringBuilder/xrefmap.yml.
